description: This file is a shell script for testing gettext support in Git, including various test cases for translation extraction, locale handling, and string translation. It sources an external script 'lib-gettext.sh' and defines multiple test expectations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description string and a command block.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for being identical.

methods.name: test -n
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.

methods.name: test $TEXTDOMAIN =
methods.description: Checks if the environment variable TEXTDOMAIN equals 'git'.

methods.name: eval_gettext
methods.description: Wrapper for evaluating gettext strings, handling variable substitution.
